ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels; white pixels are concentrated on the distal margins of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are dominated by a solid low-intensity black mass. Distal regions of both left and right lobes feature high-intensity white blobs containing low-intensity black mottling. The right lobe distal white region is larger and more complex than the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle estimated at 65 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with higher frequency and pixel-amplitude (peaks) on the distal third of both trailing edges. The medial regions of the trailing edges are relatively smoother.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in rounded, serrated points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of small, circular, high-contrast white clusters concentrated along the trailing edges and extreme tips, likely representing barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark linear scratches across the right white distal patch, including one prominent vertical-horizontal intersection forming a cross-like pattern. Additional faint horizontal scratches are visible in the central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular texture and white scarring along the entire trailing edge; distinct cross-shaped scar on the right lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-shaped (X-like) black pigment mark localized within the white patch of the right lobe's distal end.
